results.title: Bibliographie
results.overview: Janja Garnbret has nothing left to prove indoors—two Olympic golds, and more World Cup victories than any climber alive. So she heads to Céüse to attempt Bibliographie, one of the hardest routes on Earth, to discover just how far she can push herself. But when her summer project stretches into a grueling, multi-year odyssey, the woman who is used to winning is forced to confront her weaknesses like never before.

results.title: Reel Rock 20 Retrospective Film
results.overview: A short film played at the beginning of Reel Rock 20.

results.title: Chronique d’un été
results.overview: Lola sets out to create a film about happiness and love in all their forms. But as her encounters fall apart and reality refuses to follow her vision, she finds herself chasing a dream that keeps slipping away — until she meets Penelope.

results.title: Seen
results.overview: Homeless in Paris after spending everything on a low-budget film, queer undocumented filmmaker Bynone tracks down a former partner to obtain consent for an explicit scene they once shot together. As they revisit the footage, old hierarchies, racialized power dynamics, and unresolved desire resurface – and the boundary between the film-within-the-film and the film itself dissolves.

results.title: Hold On, Pain Ends
results.overview: Ben Mayforth redefines adaptive climbing in his intense pursuit of 5.13.

results.title: Try Hard - La génération qui a inventé l'esport
results.original_title: Try Hard - La génération qui a inventé l'esport
results.overview: This three-part series is intended as a manifesto for a generation that grew up with the internet and helped shape this uncharted world by bringing esports to it. It tells the story of the birth of esports, as seen through the eyes of its greatest champions: teenagers from rural France who have become stars of a global discipline, played by millions of enthusiasts.

results.title: Ultrasound
results.overview: In a future where healthcare is driven by artificial intelligence, Aitana seeks answers about her condition, but she is confronted with a system that not only analyzes her body, but also her digital life, ultimately determining her right to motherhood.

results.title: Midnight Nostalgia
results.overview: Tartu seems to breathe differently. 57-year old Maarja, a former violinist of the famous estonian punk band Vennaskond goes through the nightly city like a ghost, embodying Tartu’s bohemian spirit.

results.title: Sippiyan Sitaare
results.overview: Determined to become a top fashion designer, small-town dreamer Jagga moves to the bustling city and joins quiet tailor Samar. When sudden hardships threaten their venture, the duo must unite to rebuild their shared dream.

results.title: Sending Spree
results.overview: Michaela Kiersch goes on a global sending spree, becoming the first woman ever to climb both V15 boulders and 5.15 routes.

results.title: Alone on the Torre
results.overview: Elite alpinist Colin Haley lays everything on the line in a legendary winter solo push on Cerro Torre – one of Patagonia’s most iconic and unforgiving peaks

results.title: The Cosmic Roommates: Garbage Day
results.overview: Jake just wants a normal life, but his chaotic group of misfit roommates turns his world upside down. When mysterious, giant trash monsters threaten to destroy the city, the bickering roommates are forced to band together to save their home. To survive the ultimate garbage day, they must pull off the unthinkable and team up with their mortal enemy.

results.title: A Ring in the Night
results.overview: When the case of an incarcerated murderer is re-opened, the Detective who arrested her returns to hold an interrogation.

results.title: Bartholomew the Ecumenical Patriarch
results.overview: Thirty-five years after his elevation to the throne of the Ecumenical Patriarchate, His All-Holiness Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew recounts his long journey from his birthplace, Imbros in the 1950s, to the Phanar and present-day Constantinople.

results.title: Project Shamrock: The Secret Origins of Michael Myers Exposed
results.original_title: Project Shamrock: The Secret Origins of Michael Myers Exposed
results.overview: A recently discovered lost film reel with footage dating back to Halloween 1960 contains disturbing evidence that a young Michael Myers was once a subject of the Silver Shamrock Corporation’s top-secret experiments, conducted under the codename PROJECT SHAMROCK.

results.title: Good Therapist, Bad Therapist
results.overview: A patient in a mental hospital confronts his demons through his two therapists: the Good Therapist, and the Bad Therapist

results.title: Train To Waterloo, Courtesy Of Fishmans
results.original_title: Train To Waterloo, Courtesy Of Fishmans
results.overview: “On a train from Surbiton to Waterloo to go watch Haxan, I was listening to LONG SEASON and felt an urge to make something, so I did.”
